arch_decisions.title: Schema and DDL for practice tables and sandbox state
arch_decisions.summary: Append idempotent DDL to InitializeSystemTables that creates app.practice_questions, app.practice_attempts, app.practice_sandbox_state, and an index on app.practice_attempts(student_id, submitted_at DESC). No changes to existing app.questions, app.submissions, app.examinations, or roles.
arch_decisions.rationale: Keeping practice data in dedicated tables preserves clean exam/practice separation for analytics, avoids schema-mutating ALTERs on hot tables, and lets the existing per-exam paths remain untouched. Storing the sandbox bookkeeping in a single-row state table (id=1 CHECK) gives us idempotent insert semantics without a sequence.
arch_decisions.decision: Add three CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocks plus a CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and a guarded INSERT to the DDL block that runs inside InitializeSystemTables, appended after the existing block ending near postgres.go:539.
acceptance_criteria: Running the server twice against a fresh DB does not error on the second run (idempotent DDL).

After bootstrap, app.practice_questions has columns: id SERIAL PK, created_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES app.system_users(id), target_table TEXT NOT NULL, correct_sql TEXT NOT NULL, question_type TEXT CHECK IN ('QUERY','DML'), requirement TEXT NOT NULL, points NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 1.0, strict_ordering BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, strict_attrs BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, expected_result JSONB, expected_columns JSONB, expected_result_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK IN ('pending','captured','failed'), capture_error TEXT, expected_result_captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now().

app.practice_attempts has: id SERIAL PK, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES app.system_users(id), practice_question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES app.practice_questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sql_text TEXT NOT NULL, is_correct BOOLEAN NOT NULL, validation_details JSONB, submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now().
Index idx_practice_attempts_student exists on (student_id, submitted_at DESC).
app.practice_sandbox_state has a single row (id=1) with schema_name default 'sandbox_practice'.
No DDL was added or modified for app.questions, app.submissions, or app.examinations.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Order matters: app.system_users must be created before app.practice_questions/attempts, which is already true given existing DDL ordering. Verify the append is positioned after app.system_users CREATE TABLE.

arch_decisions.title: Practice sandbox bootstrap and reset (InitializePracticeSandbox, ResetPracticeSandbox)
arch_decisions.summary: Add two repository methods that manage the persistent sandbox_practice.* schema. InitializePracticeSandbox is idempotent: if the schema exists, no-op; otherwise create it, grant permissions to exam_student/exam_student_readonly, clone every table from public.* using the existing ensureTablesInSchema helper, and stamp app.practice_sandbox_state.created_at. ResetPracticeSandbox drops and recreates the schema, re-clones from public.*, and stamps last_reset_at.
arch_decisions.rationale: Reusing the existing CREATE TABLE LIKE INCLUDING ALL + INSERT...SELECT pattern (already implemented for exam sandboxes in ensureTablesInSchema) keeps practice in lockstep with curriculum changes and avoids re-implementing clone logic. A single shared sandbox is sufficient because savepoint-rollback semantics on every DML attempt prevent cross-student state bleed (see ARCH-008).
arch_decisions.decision: Implement InitializePracticeSandbox(ctx) error and ResetPracticeSandbox(ctx) error on *PostgresRepository. Both reuse EnsureSchema, GrantSchemaPermissions, and ensureTablesInSchema. Reset issues DROP SCHEMA sandbox_practice CASCADE before re-bootstrap. Both methods update app.practice_sandbox_state accordingly via UPDATE WHERE id=1.
acceptance_criteria: InitializePracticeSandbox is a no-op when sandbox_practice already exists (no error, no DROP).
After first call against a fresh DB, sandbox_practice contains every table listed by GetPublicTables, populated with the same row counts as public.*.
ResetPracticeSandbox truncates state by dropping and re-cloning: every table again matches public.* row counts after the call.
app.practice_sandbox_state.created_at is set on first init; last_reset_at is updated on reset.
Both methods grant the necessary permissions so exam_student / exam_student_readonly can SELECT and (for exam_student) DML against sandbox_practice tables.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: ResetPracticeSandbox must guard against running while practice DML evaluations are in flight. Acceptable risk: the global advisory-lock per target_table won't block DROP SCHEMA. Recommendation for implementor: hold pg_advisory_lock(0) (sentinel) for the duration of the reset, OR document that reset must be issued during a quiet window. Defer this hardening to TODO follow-ups.

arch_decisions.title: Practice Go models with AsQuestion() adapter
arch_decisions.summary: Create backend/internal/models/practice.go with two structs: PracticeQuestion (mirrors models.Question in submission.go:38-55 minus ExamID) and PracticeAttempt (mirrors models.Submission in submission.go:26-36 minus ExamID, with QuestionID renamed to PracticeQuestionID). Add an AsQuestion() *Question method on PracticeQuestion that builds a Question with ExamID=nil and every other field copied verbatim.
arch_decisions.rationale: Mirroring rather than embedding keeps JSON wire format clean and gives us an explicit data contract for the new table. The AsQuestion() adapter is the minimum-ripple way to let the existing ValidationService (which is typed on models.Question) accept practice questions without refactoring its method signatures or introducing a ValidatableQuestion interface.
arch_decisions.decision: PracticeQuestion fields and JSON tags must match the DDL column names from ARCH-001 (snake_case). AsQuestion() returns a *models.Question with ExamID set to nil pointer and Type, TargetTable, CorrectSQL, Points, Requirement, StrictMode{Ordering: StrictOrdering, Attributes: StrictAttrs}, ExpectedResult, ExpectedColumns, ExpectedResultStatus, ExpectedResultCapturedAt, CaptureError, CreatedBy, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt copied through. PracticeAttempt has fields: ID, StudentID, PracticeQuestionID, SQLText, IsCorrect, ValidationDetails (json.RawMessage), SubmittedAt.
acceptance_criteria: models.PracticeQuestion and models.PracticeAttempt compile and have JSON tags exactly matching DDL column names.
(*PracticeQuestion).AsQuestion() returns a *models.Question with ExamID==nil and every other relevant field populated.
go vet ./... passes; no existing code referencing models.Question or models.Submission is altered.
PracticeQuestion.StrictMode is reconstructed correctly: StrictMode.Ordering == StrictOrdering, StrictMode.Attributes == StrictAttrs.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Verify the existing Question.ExamID field is *int (not int) before adapter is implemented — confirmed by reading submission.go:40. AsQuestion must set ExamID = nil, not &zero.

arch_decisions.title: Repository CRUD for practice questions, attempts, and IsAnyExamActive probe
arch_decisions.summary: Add nine new repository methods on *PostgresRepository: CreatePracticeQuestion, UpdatePracticeQuestion, ListPracticeQuestions, GetPracticeQuestion, DeletePracticeQuestion, CreatePracticeAttempt, ListPracticeAttempts(studentID), and IsAnyExamActive. All methods use pgx parameterized queries and return models.* types.
arch_decisions.rationale: These mirror existing repository patterns for app.questions and app.submissions, so the implementor has a working reference for each method. IsAnyExamActive lives at the repository layer so the freeze middleware (ARCH-005) depends only on the repo interface and not on a higher service. Caching is a middleware concern, not a repository concern.
arch_decisions.decision: Method signatures: CreatePracticeQuestion(ctx, *models.PracticeQuestion) error (sets ID, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt on the input); UpdatePracticeQuestion(ctx, *models.PracticeQuestion) error (sets UpdatedAt); ListPracticeQuestions(ctx) ([]models.PracticeQuestion, error); GetPracticeQuestion(ctx, id int) (*models.PracticeQuestion, error); DeletePracticeQuestion(ctx, id int) error; CreatePracticeAttempt(ctx, *models.PracticeAttempt) error (sets ID, SubmittedAt); ListPracticeAttempts(ctx, studentID int) ([]models.PracticeAttempt, error); IsAnyExamActive(ctx) (bool, error) running SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app.examinations WHERE is_active = true).
acceptance_criteria: Create methods round-trip: after Create then Get, every field except auto-managed timestamps matches.
Update overwrites only the non-immutable fields (not id, not created_at, not created_by).
ListPracticeQuestions returns questions ordered by id ASC (consistent with existing patterns).
ListPracticeAttempts is filtered to the supplied studentID and ordered by submitted_at DESC.
Delete cascades to attempts via ON DELETE CASCADE (verified by inserting an attempt then deleting the question).
IsAnyExamActive returns true iff at least one app.examinations row has is_active = true.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: StrictMode fields are stored as two BOOLEAN columns (strict_ordering, strict_attrs) but the Go model exposes them as a nested StrictMode struct. Scan/Bind code must translate both directions explicitly.

arch_decisions.title: ExamFreezeMiddleware with 5s TTL cache and explicit invalidation hook
arch_decisions.summary: Create a new package backend/internal/middleware (new directory) containing exam_freeze.go. Export ExamFreezeMiddleware(repo *repository.PostgresRepository) gin.HandlerFunc and InvalidateExamFreezeCache(). The middleware short-circuits with HTTP 423 and body {"error":"practice_unavailable_during_exam"} when IsAnyExamActive returns true. Result is cached in-process behind a sync.Mutex with a 5-second TTL.
arch_decisions.rationale: Co-locating the cache in the middleware (rather than the repository) keeps the repository stateless and lets the cache be invalidated by an exported package-level function callable from lecturer controllers without circular imports. A 5-second TTL bounds DB hits to ~12 QPS per server in steady state; explicit invalidation closes the visibility gap during exam activation transitions.
arch_decisions.decision: Cache is a package-level struct { mu sync.Mutex; expires time.Time; value bool } with const ttl = 5 * time.Second. Read path: lock, if time.Now().Before(expires) return cached value, else query repo.IsAnyExamActive, update cache, return. InvalidateExamFreezeCache() sets expires = zero time so the next call refreshes. On repo error, fail-closed: return 423 (do NOT let students bypass a possibly-active exam due to a transient DB hiccup) and log the error. On 423, c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusLocked, gin.H{"error":"practice_unavailable_during_exam"}). The middleware does not handle authentication; it is mounted after AuthMiddleware + RoleMiddleware(STUDENT) in the route group.
acceptance_criteria: With no active exam, requests to a route guarded by ExamFreezeMiddleware proceed normally (next handler is called).
With at least one active exam, requests to a guarded route return 423 with JSON {"error":"practice_unavailable_during_exam"}.
Within the 5-second TTL, repeated requests consult the cache (verified by a test that counts repo.IsAnyExamActive calls).
After InvalidateExamFreezeCache(), the next request triggers a fresh DB probe regardless of TTL.
On repo error, middleware aborts with 423 (fail-closed) and logs the error.
go test -race ./... reports no data races on the cache.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Fail-closed is a policy choice. If the DB is down, lecturer authoring remains usable (its routes don't go through this middleware), but students see 423. This is the safer default — admin can deactivate exams and clear cache once DB is restored. AuthMiddleware currently lives in controllers package; placing the new middleware in its own package avoids tangling middleware concerns with controllers and provides a natural home for future middlewares.

arch_decisions.title: Wire freeze-cache invalidation into ActivateExamination and DeactivateExamination
arch_decisions.summary: At the end of ActivateExamination and DeactivateExamination handler success paths in lecturer_controller.go, call middleware.InvalidateExamFreezeCache() so the very next student practice request reflects the new state instead of waiting up to 5 seconds.
arch_decisions.rationale: Without explicit invalidation, students could submit practice during the first 5 seconds of an active exam (or be incorrectly blocked for 5 seconds after deactivation). The lecturer activation path is low-frequency and idempotent invalidation is cheap, so the cost is negligible.
arch_decisions.decision: Import the new middleware package into controllers/lecturer_controller.go and add one line — middleware.InvalidateExamFreezeCache() — immediately after each handler's successful state mutation, before returning the HTTP response. Both Activate and Deactivate paths must invalidate; activating new exam and deactivating last active exam are the two transitions that matter.
acceptance_criteria: ActivateExamination handler calls middleware.InvalidateExamFreezeCache() after the DB update succeeds.
DeactivateExamination handler calls middleware.InvalidateExamFreezeCache() after the DB update succeeds.
Invalidation is NOT called on error paths (so a failed activation does not flap the cache).
Integration: activate an exam, then within 1 second hit /api/v1/practice/questions — must return 423.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Watch for import cycles: middleware imports repository; lecturer_controller already imports repository; lecturer_controller now also imports middleware. No cycle, but verify.

arch_decisions.title: Parameterize ValidationService DML execution path on sandbox schema
arch_decisions.summary: Thread a sandbox-schema string from caller down to repository.evaluateDML and repository.evaluatePreviewDML (or equivalent), so practice can pass 'sandbox_practice' while exam continues to pass fmt.Sprintf('sandbox_exam_%d', examID). Default exam behavior must be byte-identical to current code.
arch_decisions.rationale: The plan calls for the AsQuestion() adapter (ARCH-003) to bridge model types, but the schema name is currently derived inside repository.Evaluate via ExamSandboxName(*question.ExamID). Practice questions have no ExamID. We need an explicit sandbox-schema argument to the executor path so the same code can serve both modes.
arch_decisions.decision: Extend the DBExecutor interface and the corresponding *PostgresRepository methods with an additional parameter sandboxSchema string. Signature changes: Evaluate(ctx, studentID, question, studentSQL, sandboxSchema) (models.ValidationResult, error) and EvaluatePreview(ctx, studentID, question, studentSQL, sandboxSchema) (repository.PreviewResult, error). For exam callers in quiz_controller.go and lecturer_controller.go, pass repository.ExamSandboxName(*q.ExamID). For practice callers, pass the constant 'sandbox_practice'. Inside evaluateDML/evaluatePreviewDML, use the sandboxSchema parameter in place of the local schema := ExamSandboxName(...) line. The QUERY (SELECT) path is unchanged — it always reads from public.* regardless of caller.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate and EvaluatePreview signatures include sandboxSchema string as the final parameter.
Existing exam flow tests pass without behavioral change (DML still targets sandbox_exam_{X}).
Practice DML flow targets 'sandbox_practice' schema (verified by an integration test that inserts a row and observes it within the same transaction's pre-rollback SELECT).
Evaluate returns an error 'question is not assigned to an examination' is removed or replaced: the ExamID nil check must NOT block practice. Practice callers must not hit that guard.
All call sites compile; go vet ./... clean; go test ./... green.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: The current Evaluate has a guard `if question.ExamID == nil { return error }`. The practice path will pass a synthetic Question with ExamID=nil (built via AsQuestion()), so this guard must be removed or relaxed when sandboxSchema is supplied. Implementor must either drop the guard (preferred: the sandboxSchema parameter makes the check redundant) or gate it on whether the sandboxSchema starts with 'sandbox_exam_'.

arch_decisions.title: PracticeController with five student endpoints and five lecturer endpoints
arch_decisions.summary: Create backend/internal/controllers/practice_controller.go exposing ListForStudent, GetForStudent, Submit, Preview, ListMyAttempts (student-facing) and Upsert, ListForLecturer, Delete, ResetSandbox, LecturerPreview (lecturer-facing). Each handler mirrors a documented existing handler: Submit ↔ QuizController.SubmitAnswer (quiz_controller.go:89); Preview ↔ QuizController.PreviewAnswer (quiz_controller.go:169); Upsert ↔ LecturerController.UpsertQuestion (lecturer_controller.go:129); LecturerPreview ↔ LecturerController.PreviewCorrectSQL (lecturer_controller.go:184).
arch_decisions.rationale: Mirroring battle-tested handler shapes minimizes novel logic and lets the implementor produce close-to-identical code with the practice-specific delta (PracticeQuestion via AsQuestion(), sandboxSchema='sandbox_practice', persistence to app.practice_attempts). Student-facing list/get redact correct_sql and expected_result; lecturer-facing list returns the full record.
arch_decisions.decision: Controller struct: PracticeController { repo *repository.PostgresRepository; validator *services.ValidationService; auth *services.AuthService }. Constructor NewPracticeController(repo, validator, auth) *PracticeController. Handler responsibilities: ListForStudent returns []models.PracticeQuestion with CorrectSQL and ExpectedResult fields zeroed out (use a redacted DTO or zero the fields before JSON marshal); GetForStudent does the same for one question. Submit reads student_id from JWT (never from request body), calls validator.Validate(ctx, studentID, q.AsQuestion(), sql) with sandboxSchema='sandbox_practice' threaded through (per ARCH-007), persists a PracticeAttempt regardless of correctness, returns ValidationResult. Preview is the same shape minus persistence. ListMyAttempts filters by JWT student_id. Upsert mirrors the Phase 0 expected-result capture from UpsertQuestion: capture expected_result against public.* (or sandbox_practice for DML) in a rolled-back transaction, then INSERT/UPDATE the practice_questions row with expected_result and expected_result_status='captured'. Delete removes by id. ResetSandbox calls repo.ResetPracticeSandbox(ctx). LecturerPreview mirrors PreviewCorrectSQL.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 10 endpoints is implemented as a gin.HandlerFunc method on *PracticeController.
Student endpoints take student_id ONLY from the JWT claims via the same helper QuizController uses (never from request body).
Student GET endpoints zero out CorrectSQL and ExpectedResult fields before responding.
Submit always persists a PracticeAttempt (even on incorrect or syntax_error results), with is_correct reflecting the validation outcome.
Preview never writes to app.practice_attempts.
Upsert captures expected_result and sets expected_result_status='captured' on success, 'failed' with capture_error on failure — matching the Phase 0 behavior of UpsertQuestion.
ResetSandbox is admin/lecturer-only and returns 200 with {"reset_at": <timestamp>} on success.
DML submissions are evaluated with sandboxSchema='sandbox_practice' (ARCH-007) and rolled back via savepoint so sandbox_practice state is preserved across attempts.
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Per-table advisory lock for practice DML: implement pg_advisory_lock(hash) where hash is a hash of 'practice:' + target_table. Use the same FNV-1a (or whichever the exam path uses) helper, but with the 'practice:' prefix to avoid contention with exam locks. Confirm helper location and reuse; do not invent a new hash function. Plan §Concurrency calls this out explicitly.

arch_decisions.title: Wire practice routes and bootstrap sandbox in cmd/main.go
arch_decisions.summary: Register two new gin route groups in backend/cmd/main.go (around lines 100-139): apiV1.Group('/practice') guarded by AuthMiddleware + RoleMiddleware(STUDENT) + ExamFreezeMiddleware; apiV1.Group('/lecturer/practice') guarded by AuthMiddleware + RoleMiddleware(ADMIN, LECTURER). Construct the PracticeController and the freeze middleware before the v1 group block. After repo.InitializeSystemTables(ctx) succeeds, call repo.InitializePracticeSandbox(ctx) (idempotent).
arch_decisions.rationale: Centralizing route wiring in main.go keeps routing visible and discoverable. Bootstrap must run after InitializeSystemTables so the practice_sandbox_state row insert sees the table that DDL just created. The freeze middleware is constructed once and reused as middleware across the student practice group.
arch_decisions.decision: In main.go before the v1 group: practiceCtrl := controllers.NewPracticeController(repo, valService, authService); examFreezeMW := middleware.ExamFreezeMiddleware(repo). Inside v1: add practiceStudent := v1.Group('/practice'); practiceStudent.Use(controllers.AuthMiddleware(authService), controllers.RoleMiddleware(models.RoleStudent), examFreezeMW); register GET /questions, GET /questions/:id, POST /submit, POST /preview, GET /attempts. Add practiceLecturer := v1.Group('/lecturer/practice'); practiceLecturer.Use(controllers.AuthMiddleware(authService), controllers.RoleMiddleware(models.RoleAdmin, models.RoleLecturer)); register POST /question, GET /questions, DELETE /question/:id, POST /reset-sandbox, POST /preview. After InitializeSystemTables success, call if err := repo.InitializePracticeSandbox(ctx); err != nil { log.Fatalf(...) }.
acceptance_criteria: Server boots successfully against a fresh DB and creates sandbox_practice automatically.
Server boots successfully a second time without error (idempotency).
All 10 documented endpoints are reachable at the documented paths (verified by hitting each with curl or Bruno).
Student endpoints return 401 without JWT, 403 with non-student JWT, 423 with active exam, and 200 in the steady state.
Lecturer endpoints return 401/403 likewise; never 423 (no freeze middleware on lecturer group).
arch_decisions.risks_notes: Confirm method-name spelling consistency with ARCH-008 — implementor of [9] must reference the same exported method names produced by [8].

arch_decisions.title: Frontend: router, practice views, App.vue nav, practice API service, 423 toast
arch_decisions.summary: Add /practice (student) and /lecturer/practice (lecturer/admin) routes to frontend/src/router.ts. Create PracticeView.vue and PracticeAuthoring.vue heavily reusing SqlEditor.vue, ResultTable.vue, NotificationToast.vue. Add a Practice nav link (student) and a Practice Authoring nav link (lecturer/admin) in App.vue. Create frontend/src/services/practice.ts API client. Centralize 423 handling: on a 423 response, display a NotificationToast with text 'Practice unavailable while an exam is active.' and disable submit/preview buttons.
arch_decisions.rationale: Mirroring existing student/lecturer components keeps the UX consistent and lets the implementor copy interaction patterns from LecturerView.vue / StudentView.vue. A single API service module centralizes auth-header injection and 423 detection so every practice call benefits from the same UX without duplication.
arch_decisions.decision: Router additions: { path: '/practice', component: PracticeView, meta: { requiresAuth: true, role: 'STUDENT' } } and { path: '/lecturer/practice', component: PracticeAuthoring, meta: { requiresAuth: true, roles: ['ADMIN','LECTURER'] } }. practice.ts exports: listQuestions(), getQuestion(id), submit(id, sql), preview(id, sql), listMyAttempts(); and for lecturer: lecturerListQuestions(), upsertQuestion(payload), deleteQuestion(id), resetSandbox(), lecturerPreview(payload). Use existing axios/fetch wrapper (whichever the codebase uses; check frontend/src/services/). 423 detection: in the response interceptor, if status === 423, emit a toast event and reject the promise with a typed error so callers can disable UI without crashing.
acceptance_criteria: bun run build completes without TypeScript or Vue errors.
Student logged in: /practice loads, lists questions, allows submit and preview, shows attempt history.
Lecturer logged in: /lecturer/practice loads, allows create/edit/delete of questions, and triggers reset-sandbox.
When backend returns 423, the UI shows a toast 'Practice unavailable while an exam is active.' and submit/preview controls are disabled.
Nav: student users see a Practice link; lecturer/admin users see a Practice Authoring link; students do NOT see the Authoring link.

  var cache struct {
    mu      sync.Mutex
    expires time.Time
    value   bool
  }
  const ttl = 5 * time.Second

Exported symbols:

func ExamFreezeMiddleware(repo *repository.PostgresRepository) gin.HandlerFunc {
  Returns a gin.HandlerFunc that:
  1. cache.mu.Lock()
  2. If time.Now().Before(cache.expires): use cache.value, cache.mu.Unlock().
  3. Else: call active, err := repo.IsAnyExamActive(c.Request.Context()).
     Update cache.value = active, cache.expires = time.Now().Add(ttl). cache.mu.Unlock().
     On error: log.Printf the error, cache.mu.Unlock(), abort with 423.
  4. If active==true: c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusLocked, gin.H{"error": "practice_unavailable_during_exam"}).
  5. Else: c.Next().
  Note: unlock mu BEFORE calling c.AbortWithStatusJSON or c.Next() to avoid holding lock during handler chain.
}

func InvalidateExamFreezeCache() {
  cache.mu.Lock()
  cache.expires = time.Time{}
  cache.mu.Unlock()
}
